summary: Confirmed all 18 estimates against the paper after reading the entire 48-page markdown conversion, including Appendices A-E and references. All 74 estimate source entries match their cited PDF pages after normalizing layout whitespace and discretionary soft-hyphen line breaks. Arm means, SDs, pairwise Bonferroni-corrected p-values, and printed d values agree with PDF pp. 20 and 22 and belong to the recorded outcomes and arm contrasts. The analyzed counts are human-only 64, general-AI 67, and regulated-AI 65 (PDF p. 8 and Table 4, PDF p. 20); the full study analyzes 196 participants. Unprinted two-arm totals correctly remain null. The four script flags are false positives: the regulated-AI versus general-AI product-improvement effects are printed as d = − 0.62 for originality (PDF p. 20), d = − 0.60 for usefulness (PDF p. 22), and d = − 1.13 for elaboration (PDF p. 22). Spaces after the Unicode minus signs do not change these negative values. The regulated-AI versus human-only product-improvement usefulness sentence is present on PDF p. 22 with p = 1.00 and d = −0.13; PyMuPDF splits the word differ as dif followed by a soft hyphen and a line break before fer. The recorded quote and numbers are correct. Question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, AI availability, timing, within_person, comparison_type, and se_basis conform to the codebook: the intervention product-improvement outputs are with_ai, subsequent unassisted product-invention outputs are after_ai, and both occur in the same session. Experts average their ratings for each participant before analysis (PDF pp. 15-16), supporting participant units, SD levels, and uncertainty. Elaboration is detail rather than necessarily greater creativity, appropriately explained under higher_is = other. All three reported arm contrasts for originality, usefulness, and elaboration on both tasks are included. No eligible outcome or contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6. Baseline measures, self-reports, prompt-process counts, correlations, mediation effects, and illustrative appendix responses are appropriately excluded; figure-only statistics remain untranscribed under rule 1.
